description: A structure satisfies \(\delta_n\land\neg\delta_{n+1}\) if and only if its domain has exactly \(n\) elements, where \(\delta_k\) asserts at least \(k\) elements.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Compactness.exact_size_sentence.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type w}
  [L.Structure M] (n : ℕ) :
  M ⊨
      FirstOrder.Language.Sentence.cardGe L n ⊓
        FirstOrder.Language.Formula.not (FirstOrder.Language.Sentence.cardGe L (n + 1)) ↔
    Cardinal.mk M = ↑n
